snapshot.text: Free public system run by the Ministry of Health (MINSA) with a strong community health model, and limited independent information. Work with PAHO in 2026 covered digital health, chronic disease surveillance and leprosy elimination.

priorities.title: Digital health and primary care
priorities.text: Advancing a more connected primary care system with digital health.

priorities.title: Leprosy elimination
priorities.text: The ministry is stepping up actions towards eliminating leprosy.
